name: kickwise
description: The Kickwise AI's football (soccer) match predictions: win, draw and away win chances, the AI's pick and an exact score prediction about an hour before kickoff, AI match summaries (preview, live or recap) with the starting lineups, and the AI's public graded track record.

interface.longDescription:
Kickwise publishes an AI model's predictions for football (soccer) matches, made before kickoff, and grades every call in public.

Ask for today's or tomorrow's matches, or one league over the coming days (Premier League, Champions League, La Liga, Ligue 1, Serie A, Bundesliga, Saudi Pro League, Egyptian Premier League, Botola Pro, Liga MX, Brasileirão and MLS). Each match comes with the chance of a home win, a draw and an away win, the AI's pick, the kickoff time and a link to its kickwise.ai page with lineups, the live score and where to watch.

About an hour before kickoff, once the confirmed lineups are out, the AI also predicts the exact final score. Ask for a match summary and Kickwise gives the AI's preview before kickoff, a live reading during the match or a recap after it, written from recent form, the confirmed lineups and injuries, formations, statistics and key moments, together with both starting lineups and formations. Once a match is over, Kickwise says whether the pick and the exact score were right.

What makes Kickwise different is that every call is made before kickoff, time stamped and graded in public at kickwise.ai/ai/record, misses included. As of 21 October 2026, its confident picks (the AI gave its pick 65% or more) were right 84% of the time over the last 90 days (54 of 64), against 63% for always picking the home team on the same matches; across every call in the last 30 days it was right 65% of the time (82 of 126).

No account needed: the tools receive only the team, league, day and language a question needs, never your conversation or anything about you, as the privacy policy at kickwise.ai/privacy sets out. Team names and links in English, Spanish, French, Arabic or Portuguese. The predictions are estimates for entertainment and discussion, not betting advice: Kickwise shows no odds and does not offer or promote betting.
capabilities: Football match predictions by day or league
Exact score prediction an hour before kickoff
AI match previews, live summaries and recaps
Answers in English, Spanish, French, Arabic and Portuguese
defaultPrompt: What are the Kickwise AI's predictions for today's football matches?
Who does the Kickwise AI pick in Real Madrid's next match?
Which matches is the Kickwise AI most confident about tomorrow?

positive.prompt: What are the Kickwise AI's predictions for today's football matches?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists today's matches with the home win, draw and away win chances, the AI's pick, the kickoff time in UTC and a kickwise.ai link for each, and notes the predictions are not betting advice.

positive.prompt: Show me the Kickwise predictions for the Premier League this week.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_predictions with league premier-league and lists the coming Premier League matches; a match without a published call is shown as not published yet, never with an invented number.

positive.description: A team's next match and its exact score
positive.prompt: Who does the Kickwise AI pick in Real Madrid's next match, and what score does it predict?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Real Madrid's live or next match and gives the AI's chances and pick (or says the call is not published yet), plus the exact score prediction once the lineups are out (or says it comes about an hour before kickoff), with the match link.

positive.description: Match summary with the starting lineups
positive.prompt: Give me a preview of Liverpool's next match with the starting lineups.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the Kickwise AI preview of Liverpool's next match (a live summary or recap if it is in play or over), the AI's call, and both starting lineups with formations once announced, or says the lineups are not announced yet.

positive.prompt: How accurate is the Kickwise AI?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the high confidence record (picks of 65% or more) with the percent right and number of calls, the last 30 days and all time figures, the always pick the home team comparison, and the link to the public record.

negative.description: Betting request: Kickwise offers no odds, bookmakers or stakes, so the plugin should not be used to place or size bets; expected a refusal or a note that Kickwise only gives predictions for discussion, not betting advice.
negative.prompt: Which bookmaker has the best odds on Liverpool tonight, and how much should I bet?

negative.description: Write action: the plugin is read only and cannot place picks on the Kickwise leaderboard; expected an explanation that picks are made on kickwise.ai/predict, with no tool claiming to save a pick.
negative.prompt: Put my prediction on the Kickwise leaderboard: Arsenal to win on Saturday.

negative.description: Unrelated request: nothing to do with football predictions, so no Kickwise tool should be called.
negative.prompt: What will the weather be in London tomorrow?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: football match predictions by day or league, the exact score prediction an hour before kickoff, AI match summaries with the starting lineups, one match's AI call, and the AI's graded track record.
